title: Architecting Tensor Core-Based Reductions for Irregular Molecular Docking Kernels
problem: Tensor Cores are optimized for dense matrix operations but molecular docking has irregular computation patterns; their adoption in such HPC applications remains limited.
motivation: Tensor Cores offer high compute density; molecular docking is compute-intensive but irregular; TC-based accelerations could significantly improve performance if accuracy is preserved.
method: Twofold strategy: (1) accelerate sum reduction operations using Tensor Cores, (2) apply numerical error correction (EC) techniques to maintain accuracy. CUDA implementation on A100, H100, B200.
key_novelty: Systematic methodology for integrating Tensor Cores into irregular HPC kernels via reduction acceleration + numerical error correction.
contributions: Numerical error correction preserving algorithmic accuracy
Consistent performance gains on A100, H100, B200
primary_theme: Tensor Core utilization for irregular molecular docking via reduction acceleration and error correction
